title: ParallelPathRun.v1
description: The record of running a baseline path AND each candidate path on the SAME input_snapshot for one capability_slot. input_snapshot_hash is the sha256 of the canonical bytes of the input the engine fed to every path — the proof that baseline and candidates saw identical input (apples to apples). baseline_result is the ONLY result that may serve truth; candidate_results are recorded for comparison and NEVER served. served_path_id pins which path was actually served (always the baseline's path_id) and candidate_served MUST be false — a true value is structurally rejected, so the engine cannot smuggle a candidate's output to the consumer. Each per-path result carries output (or null), the output_contract it claimed, cost, latency_ms, an error (or null), source_handle_coverage (fraction of baseline's source handles preserved), contract_validation (did the output validate against its declared output_contract), and the source_handles it grounded on.

run_id.description: stable id of this parallel run (hash of capability_slot + input_snapshot_hash + path ids)

capability_slot.description: the capability whose paths were run

input_snapshot_hash.description: sha256 of the canonical bytes of the SAME input_snapshot fed to baseline + every candidate

baseline_result.description: the baseline path's result — the ONLY result that may serve truth

mode.description: the served result must be a baseline (or executed fallback) — never a candidate/shadow/canary

output.description: the baseline output (any JSON shape per output_contract); null on error

output_contract.description: the schema ref the output claims to satisfy

latency_ms.description: injected/measured latency in ms (>= 0); no wall-clock

error.description: error string, or null when the path succeeded

source_handle_coverage.description: fraction in [0,1] of grounding source handles present (baseline defines the reference set)

contract_validation.description: did the output validate against output_contract

source_handles.description: the source handles this path grounded its output on

input_snapshot_hash.description: per-path ATTESTATION of the input this path executed on — MUST equal the run-level input_snapshot_hash (every path saw the same input). The comparator rejects any path whose attestation diverges from the baseline's / run's.

candidate_results.description: one result per candidate path, run on the identical input_snapshot; recorded for comparison, NEVER served

mode.description: a challenger mode; its output is recorded but not served as truth

output.description: the candidate output (any JSON shape per output_contract); null on error

error.description: error string, or null when the path succeeded

input_snapshot_hash.description: per-candidate ATTESTATION of the input this candidate executed on — MUST equal the run-level input_snapshot_hash (the proof the candidate ran on the SAME input as the baseline). A candidate whose attestation != the baseline's is a DIFFERENT-input comparison: the comparator sets same_input=false and recommends 'investigate'; promotion is impossible.

served_path_id.description: the path_id whose output was actually served — ALWAYS the baseline's path_id

candidate_served.description: pinned false — a candidate's output is NEVER served as truth; a true value is structurally rejected
